title: FOIL Programme
description: Programme projection for FOIL. Facets are declared at section level only. Field-level forms, native pointers and the dependency list must be confirmed by the FOIL kernel owner (see handoff/v2.2/FEEDBACK_TO_FOIL.md item 4) before this pack is marked reviewed. The pack contains no physics, CAD or LCOE logic.
